name: Human
tagline: Resourceful, versatile, and endlessly ambitious innovators
description: Humans are known for their adaptability, endurance, and boundless curiosity. Found throughout the multiverse, they build empires, delve dungeons, and master diverse crafts.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: You gain an Origin Feat of your choice in addition to the one granted by your background.

name: Elf
tagline: Graceful immortals with deep magical ties and sharp senses
description: Elves are magical people of otherworldly grace, living in the world but not entirely part of it. They love nature, art, and music.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: You are descended from one of the first elf bloodlines: Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition on yourself.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation.

lineages.name: Drow
lineages.description: Adapted to the Underdark with superior darkvision and faerie magic.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Your Darkvision range is 120 feet.

traits.name: Drow Magic
traits.description: You know the Dancing Lights cantrip. At level 3 you learn Faerie Fire, and at level 5 Darkness.

lineages.name: High Elf
lineages.description: Infused with arcane magic and graceful precision.

traits.name: High Elf Magic
traits.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the Wizard spell list (e.g. Prestidigitation or Fire Bolt). Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace it.

traits.name: Arcane Mastery
traits.description: At level 3 learn Detect Magic, and at level 5 Misty Step.

lineages.name: Wood Elf
lineages.description: Fleet of foot with instinctual druidic gifts.

traits.name: Fleet of Foot
traits.description: Your walking speed is increased to 35 feet.

traits.name: Wood Elf Magic
traits.description: You know the Druidcraft cantrip. At level 3 learn Longstrider, and at level 5 Pass without Trace.

name: Dwarf
tagline: Stout, resilient subterranean champions carved from bedrock
description: Dwarves were raised from stone and forge. Renowned for their endurance, craftsmanship, and ancient subterranean fortresses.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 120 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes while touching stone surfaces. Uses equal to PB per Long Rest.

name: Halfling
tagline: Nimble, lucky homebodies with immense courage when tested
description: Halflings cherish peaceful comforts, good meals, and close bonds. Though small, their uncanny luck and bravery make them legendary adventurers.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can take the Hide action even when obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

name: Dragonborn
tagline: Proud dragon-kin unleashing elemental breath and draconic vigor
description: Dragonborn carry the majesty and destructive fury of true dragons, possessing scaled hide, elemental breath, and unyielding honor.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Choose your lineage: Black (Acid), Blue (Lightning), Brass (Fire), Bronze (Lightning), Copper (Acid), Gold (Fire), Green (Poison), Red (Fire), Silver (Cold), or White (Cold).

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: Exhale elemental power in a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line (1d10 damage on failed Dex/Con save). Usable PB times per Long Rest, replacing one attack.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have Resistance to the damage type associated with your Draconic Ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Draconic Flight (Level 5)
traits.description: At level 5, sprout spectral dragon wings as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes (flying speed equal to speed).

lineages.name: Black (Acid)
lineages.description: Acid breath (30-ft line, Dex save) and Acid resistance.

lineages.name: Blue (Lightning)
lineages.description: Lightning breath (30-ft line, Dex save) and Lightning resistance.

lineages.name: Brass (Fire)
lineages.description: Fire breath (30-ft line, Dex save) and Fire resistance.

lineages.name: Bronze (Lightning)
lineages.description: Lightning breath (30-ft line, Dex save) and Lightning resistance.

lineages.name: Copper (Acid)
lineages.description: Acid breath (30-ft line, Dex save) and Acid resistance.

lineages.name: Gold (Fire)
lineages.description: Fire breath (15-ft cone, Dex save) and Fire resistance.

lineages.name: Green (Poison)
lineages.description: Poison breath (15-ft cone, Con save) and Poison resistance.

lineages.name: Red (Fire)
lineages.description: Fire breath (15-ft cone, Dex save) and Fire resistance.

lineages.name: Silver (Cold)
lineages.description: Cold breath (15-ft cone, Con save) and Cold resistance.

lineages.name: White (Cold)
lineages.description: Cold breath (15-ft cone, Con save) and Cold resistance.

name: Gnome
tagline: Inquisitive inventors and illusionists with quick minds
description: Gnomes celebrate life, discovery, invention, and nature magic with bright enthusiasm and indomitable curiosity.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.description: You are descended from Forest Gnomes or Rock Gnomes.

lineages.name: Forest Gnome
lineages.description: Attuned to woods and beasts with illusion magic.

traits.name: Natural Illusionist
traits.description: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.description: You always have Speak with Animals prepared and can cast it PB times per Long Rest without spell slots.

lineages.name: Rock Gnome
lineages.description: Natural artisans and tinkerers of clocks and gadgets.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.description: You know Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips and can craft tiny clockwork devices.

name: Orc
tagline: Indomitable survivors blessed with boundless stamina and adrenaline
description: Orcs are staunch allies and fearless champions, drawing deep resilience and ferocity from their heritage.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, take the Dash action and gain temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Usable PB times per Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 120 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Recharges on a Long Rest.

name: Tiefling
tagline: Fiendish descendants bearing otherworldly grace and infernal flame
description: Tieflings touch the planar fires of the Lower Planes, manifesting horns, sharp gazes, and innate fiendish spellcraft.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description: Choose Abyssal (Poison), Chthonic (Necrotic), or Infernal (Fire).

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip.

lineages.name: Abyssal
lineages.description: Tainted by chaos and the Abyss. Poison Resistance and Poison Spray cantrip.

traits.name: Abyssal Magic
traits.description: You have Poison Resistance and know Poison Spray. At level 3 Ray of Sickness, level 5 Hold Person.

lineages.name: Chthonic
lineages.description: Tied to Hades and the Shadowfell. Necrotic Resistance and Chill Touch cantrip.

traits.name: Chthonic Magic
traits.description: You have Necrotic Resistance and know Chill Touch. At level 3 False Life, level 5 Ray of Enfeeblement.

lineages.name: Infernal
lineages.description: Descended from the Nine Hells. Fire Resistance and Fire Bolt cantrip.

traits.name: Infernal Magic
traits.description: You have Fire Resistance and know Fire Bolt. At level 3 Hellish Rebuke, level 5 Darkness.

name: Aasimar
tagline: Mortal champions infused with the holy radiance of the Upper Planes
description: Aasimar are mortals touched by the sacred light of Mount Celestia and Elysium, sent to be defenders of justice and hope.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage and Radiant damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.description: As a Magic action, touch a creature to restore HP equal to 1d4 + your character level (1d4+1 at Level 1). Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.description: You know the Light cantrip.

traits.name: Celestial Revelation (Level 3)
traits.description: At level 3, transform for 1 minute unleashing angelic wings or radiant light.

name: Goliath
tagline: Towering mountain champions imbued with primordial giant ancestry
description: Goliaths are giant-kin hailing from mountain peaks, possessing immense physical stature, stone-carved muscle, and giant boons.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: Choose one giant supernatural boon: Cloud, Fire, Frost, Hill, Stone, or Storm (usable PB times per Long Rest).

traits.name: Large Form (Level 5)
traits.description: At level 5, become Large size as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes with +10 ft speed.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws to end the Grappled condition, and you count as one size larger for carrying capacity and pushing/dragging.

lineages.name: Cloud Giant
lineages.description: Cloud's Jaunt: As a Bonus Action, magically teleport up to 30 feet.

lineages.name: Fire Giant
lineages.description: Fire's Burn: Deal an extra 1d10 Fire damage when hitting with an attack.

lineages.name: Frost Giant
lineages.description: Frost's Chill: Deal 1d6 extra Cold damage and reduce target speed by 10 ft.

lineages.name: Hill Giant
lineages.description: Hill's Tumble: Knock a Large or smaller creature Prone on hit.

lineages.name: Stone Giant
lineages.description: Stone's Endurance: As a Reaction on taking damage, reduce damage by 1d12 + Con mod.

lineages.name: Storm Giant
lineages.description: Storm's Thunder: As a Reaction on taking damage, deal 1d8 Thunder damage to the attacker.
